answer: Quadratic staking erosion mandates that marginal capital requirements scale super-linearly as a cluster grows, effectively turning the protocol into an anchor for decentralized honesty. By imposing aggressive slashing rules proportional to the square of malicious stake, the system forces attackers to liquidate a dune of assets, ensuring the net utility of any breach remains strictly negative. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions further crystallize this defensive posture, preventing rapid Sybil propagation and securing the Nash equilibrium against all predatory subgame deviations.
